title: Valuation policy-delta attribution waterfall
description: Decomposes the value difference between active engine policy settings and own policy baselines into per-factor contributions. Permanent engine telemetry — not a one-off analysis.
decompositionMethodNotes: Shapley values average each factor's marginal contribution over all coalitions of the remaining factors (16 valuations for 4 factors).
Order of substitution does not bias attributions; economic interactions are distributed across factors.
attr_rounding_residual_cents is integer rounding noise only — not unattributed interaction residual.

Sequential substitution (order-dependent) is NOT used. If a future revision switches, the schema must declare sequential + document the canonical order as convention, and residual must be labeled interaction-inclusive.
streetRoleNotes: diagnostic_gap_vs_street_cents / diagnostic_gap_vs_street_bps are post-hoc diagnostics only.
Street must never enter the value function or any factor baseline.
Forbidden: using diagnostic_gap_vs_street_* or attr_*_vs_street* as acceptance criteria, calibration objective, or high-signal gate.
Primary calibration criterion remains point-in-time realized driver error (PIT backtest) — a separate project when PIT store exists.

rates.active: resolve_cost_of_equity full (industry shrink, through-cycle prior, leverage beta floor)
rates.baseline: unit-beta CAPM: rf + 1.0 × ERP (no industry shrink, no leverage floor)

horizon.active: derive_hold_years + derive_fade_years from current engine policy
horizon.baseline: hold=0, fade=10 (canonical long fade, no explicit hold)

path.active: engine near_growth_bps from forward evidence normalization
path.baseline: near_growth_bps=0 (no growth capitalization beyond current EPS level)

g_terminal.active: ProjectionPolicy macro_stable + rf buffer + minimum terminal spread from engine

outputs.vBaselineCents: value with all factors at own-policy baseline (EPS capitalised)
outputs.holdActive/fadeActive/holdBaseline/fadeB: raw horizon settings for validating horizon=$0
outputs.horizonSettingsMatchBaseline: true ⇒ horizon factor inert by construction
outputs.diagnosticGapVsStreetBps: relative bps vs Street; diagnostic only
outputs.diagnosticBaselineGapVsStreetCents: vBaseline − Street; share of gap already in baseline
outputs.vNaiveFcffBaselineCents: METHOD diagnostic (not Shapley): same policy baseline projection on normalized FCFF/share instead of EPS

pitStoreDependency.note: Empirical fade/hold calibration via point-in-time fundamentals is a separate project. This waterfall must not silently assume a PIT store exists.
